, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the main function of photosynthetic cells. Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy (food), making option C the correct answer. The Planner mistakenly focused on the role of stomata/guard cells (which regulate gas exchange) and conflated "photosynthetic cells" with the mechanism of gas intake, leading to the wrong conclusion (D).
